description: Enugu State CityGML LOD1 3D Building Model: The First Open-Access Semantic 3D City Model for Nigeria and Among the First in Sub-Saharan Africa is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Chukwuma Ugwu (University of Applied Science Stuttgart (HFT Stuttgart)). Overview This dataset presents the first city-scale CityGML Level of Detail 1 (LOD1) 3D building model for Enugu State, Nigeria, and to the authors' knowledge, the first openly published semantic 3D city model for any city in Sub-Saharan Africa. Coverage: continental (NG); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
